result.finding: Spring Boot application with embedded Apache Tomcat 9.x (Servlet 4.0 / Java EE 8) provided via spring-boot-starter-web. Packaged as an executable JAR - no external servlet container required.
evidence: No web.xml found (annotation-based Spring MVC configuration only)
No @WebServlet or @WebFilter annotations - uses Spring MVC dispatcher servlet auto-configured by Spring Boot
Photo entity uses javax.persistence (Java EE 8 namespace, consistent with Servlet 4.0)
No container-specific configuration files (weblogic.xml, jboss-web.xml, etc.)
